Title: Azure Databases extension for Visual Studio Code

Body.Content:
The Azure Cosmos DB extension for Visual Studio Code is now gaining support for Azure PostgreSQL, and with the occasion is being renamed Azure Databases.

Use this extension manage and query databases, including Cosmos DB and PostgreSQL. It’s also compatible with Azure Database for PostgreSQL too.

The Azure Databases extension is now available for free from the Visual Studio Code marketplace.
